pixel_observations: Source front, oblique and top agree on two occupied storeys, paired chamfered front bays, deep continuous cornice, flat parapet roof and source-defining curved external stair. Delivered front/front-corner/top/aerial preserve that identity.

Whole left/right/rear/rear-side elevations complete the envelope and its window grammar. No blank carrier, floating base or clipped roof termination is visible; complete base/stair footprint has neutral margins.
Roof contact shows a seated continuous roof, closed chamfered cornice corners, bounded cap tiers and connected roof fittings. No prior dangling corner tabs or open roof gaps are visible.

Glass, facade and side-projection close views show cut wall sections, narrow recessed frames, separate optical panes and interior furniture/room depth. Side and rear windows are visibly apertures rather than frames on solid walls.

Stair/architecture close views show separate upper/lower front door thresholds meeting platforms; stair joins upper landing with a closed return guard, continuous stringers and grade bearing. Landing columns reach grade. Side entry has its own short stepped approach.

All 14 individual 1440x1080 render files, three source images and four boards were opened fresh at original detail. Phone comparisons retain readable stacked-duplex identity and stair connections. Semantic clay materials are consistent; no textured material claim is made.
limitations: Review reuses the exact existing v004 model; no new geometry or re-render was authored in this review.
Architectural-clay approval only. Not a textured keeper, surveyed scale, engineering, accessibility or code-compliance certification.
Right/rear elevations, partitions and furnishing are declared inference; surrounding neighbours, garden, public sidewalk and street are excluded context.
One complete stacked-duplex assembly at native size. No stretching, floor repetition or sibling substitution.

Entrances require runtime verification: front lower entry and curved stair upper entry share front approach space; an additional side lower-flat entry projects left. Reserve complete measured bounds, not 10.4x13.8 nominal wall dimensions.
No runtime entrance anchors were measured or approved by this task. Test connections at ground approach points, never at upper-floor door elevation; preserve side-step clearance.
Sol still must test Currie terrain contact, orientation, collision envelope, entry-to-sidewalk connections, edits, undo/reload and export. No browser check or seed was performed.
